description: Elections Commission - R. Liyanage of the Gampaha Municipal Council has vacated her office of member of the Sri Lanka Freedom Party - K. V. Karunarathna of the Kalawana Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna
reasoning: This gazette contains notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices as members of local government bodies (Gampaha Municipal Council and Kalawana Pradeshiya Sabha) due to ceasing membership in their respective political parties. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7).
